row.title: Attempt on Dimension-free log-concave Poincare or Cheeger constant
row.statement: ATTEMPT RECORD from the Codex campaign (author-checked by that worker only). Method: Gaussian special case by orthogonal expansion Result: For standard Gaussian measure, expand a polynomial f in orthonormal multivariate Hermite polynomials with coefficients a_alpha. Then Var(f)=sum_(|alpha|>=1) a_alpha^2 <= sum |alpha| a_alpha^2 = E||gradient f||^2. Closure in Gaussian Sobolev norm extends the inequality to its natural domain. Check: The constant is attained by any nonconstant linear function, checking both normalization and dimension independence. Obstruction: A general isotropic log-concave measure lacks this diagonal Hermite generator. This special case does not prove its uniform Poincare or Cheeger bound.
assumptions: Refers to the open problem node open-problem-p0017-dimension-free-log-concave-poincare-or-cheeger-constant
